title: The Most Overlooked Way to Make Money On the Internet
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Niche directory portfolio
idea.one_liner: Build niche directory websites that answer specific searches, attract organic traffic and earn mainly from ads and digital products.

idea.revenue_model: Display ads and digital products; sponsored listings are another possible but more hands-on model.
